response.sql: WITH avgs AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS a FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS oa FROM avgs), kept AS (SELECT avgs.equipref, avgs.a, overall.oa FROM avgs, overall WHERE avgs.a > overall.oa), km AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS ka FROM kept) SELECT kept.equipref AS equipref, kept.a AS avg_humidity, kept.a - kept.oa AS excess_over_overall_avg, kept.a - km.ka AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept, km WHERE kept.oa IS NOT NULL AND km.ka IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
